description: This Java source file defines the JournalEntryAggregationJobListener class, which implements the JobExecutionListener interface for managing job lifecycle events related to journal entry aggregation. It handles initializing date contexts before the job runs, handling rollback on failure, and logging post-execution summaries.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens to the execution lifecycle of journal entry aggregation jobs, managing initialization, rollback, and logging.

methods.name: beforeJob
methods.description: Initializes date contexts before the job execution, setting aggregated on/off dates based on provided parameters or defaults.

methods.name: initializeDates
methods.description: Sets aggregated date ranges in the job execution context, handling first-time or subsequent runs.

methods.name: afterJob
methods.description: Handles post-job actions, including rollback if the job didn't succeed and logging summary details.

methods.name: logJobExecutionSummary
methods.description: Logs detailed summary of job execution including date ranges, record counts, durations, and tenant info.
